verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Replicate is a model-hosting API provider, so an OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions OpenAI SDK compatibility or a drop-in base-URL swap. The evidence covers only general model running, scaling, pricing, and an available Node.js quickstart.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key
